note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled offline as backend/library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). Quotations are verbatim OWB spans, spliced by script; a partial verse is the shortest contiguous OWB span carrying the clause. Citations keep the Amharic library's book names.

Isaiah 54:2 is quoted identically in the long bio (block 7) and the Q&A; the 'Be still' section heading follows the OWB wording of Psalm 46:10 (ተዉ) so heading and body agree. Matthew 28:19 (block 4) is indirect speech in the biographer's voice and Romans 11:33 (block 20) is Carey's own exclamation, not a quotation; both are prose, left as translated, and stay self_rendered.
